cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm getting this shed organized. Your tools deserve proper shelves; would you like to decide where everything belongs?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only until you dump paint tins wherever you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll carry the tins and you assign their places. I'll follow the labels; that will be our system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including a shelf you're not allowed to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. I'll announce that rule myself. Pick the shelf you want protected, and I'll clear it first if you'll take on the rest.

reason: Make A rebrand yielding tool-space control as A system, then accept a no-touch rule and offer labor to secure B voluntary sorting under face-saving leadership.
